set -euo pipefail

cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps

  exit 50

trap 'sudo -n systemctl start photomap.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT

for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  if curl -fsS --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:8000/health >/dev/null; then break; fi
  sleep 1
done

PYTHONPATH=backend backend/.venv/bin/python - <<'PY' > .dev/mpo-public-sample-a47d2e8.tsv
from PIL import Image
from sqlmodel import Session, create_engine, select
from app.core.config import DATABASE_URL
from app.models.city import City
from app.models.photo import Photo
from app.models.place import Place
from app.services.photo_media import private_photo_image_path, photo_image_media_type
engine=create_engine(DATABASE_URL, connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
with Session(engine) as s:
    photos=list(s.exec(select(Photo).join(Place, Photo.place_id == Place.id).join(City, Place.city_id == City.id).where(Photo.status == 'approved', Place.status == 'published', City.status == 'active').order_by(Photo.id)).all())
for p in photos:
    path=private_photo_image_path(p)
    if not p.original_path.lower().endswith('.bin'):
        continue
    with Image.open(path) as im:
        if im.format == 'MPO':
            mime=photo_image_media_type(path)
            if mime != 'image/jpeg':
                raise SystemExit(f'helper mime mismatch: {mime}')
            print(f'{p.id}\t{path}\t{p.public_path}')
            break
else:
    raise SystemExit('no public MPO sample found')
PY
IFS=$'\t' read -r photo_id original url < .dev/mpo-public-sample-a47d2e8.tsv
tmp=.dev/mpo-http-a47d2e8.bin
hdr=.dev/mpo-http-a47d2e8.headers
curl -fsS --max-time 60 -D "$hdr" "http://127.0.0.1:8000$url" -o "$tmp"
orig_sha=$(sha256sum "$original" | awk '{print $1}')
http_sha=$(sha256sum "$tmp" | awk '{print $1}')
ctype=$(awk 'BEGIN{IGNORECASE=1} /^content-type:/{gsub("\r",""); print $0}' "$hdr" | tail -n1)
echo "mpo_hash_check photo=$photo_id original=$orig_sha http=$http_sha $ctype"
test "$orig_sha" = "$http_sha"
printf '%s\n' "$ctype" | grep -qi '^content-type: image/jpeg'
backend/.venv/bin/python scripts/diagnose_local_data.py --output-json .dev/diagnose-final-a47d2e8.json
backend/.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
r=json.loads(Path('.dev/diagnose-final-a47d2e8.json').read_text())
s=r['summary']
print('diagnostics_status=' + r['status'])
print('diagnostics_issues=' + json.dumps(s['issues'], sort_keys=True))
print('diagnostics_storage=' + json.dumps(s['storage'], sort_keys=True))
if s['issues']['by_severity']['error'] != 0:
    raise SystemExit(51)
if s['storage']['orphan_private_files'] != 0 or s['storage']['orphan_public_files'] != 0:
    raise SystemExit(52)
PY
backend/.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
conn=sqlite3.connect('backend/data/app.db')
try:
    integrity=conn.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchone()[0]
    approved=conn.execute("select count(*) from photo where status='approved'").fetchone()[0]
    api_urls=conn.execute("select count(*) from photo where status='approved' and public_path like '/api/places/%/photos/%/media/image'").fetchone()[0]
    legacy=conn.execute("select count(*) from photo where status='approved' and public_path like '/media/%'").fetchone()[0]
    print(f'sqlite_integrity={integrity} approved={approved} api_urls={api_urls} legacy_urls={legacy}')
    if integrity != 'ok' or approved != 1188 or api_urls != 1188 or legacy != 0:
        raise SystemExit(53)
finally:
    conn.close()
PY
echo '=== FINAL DISK ==='
du -sb backend/storage
df -B1 / | tail -n1
curl -fsS --max-time 10 -o /dev/null -w 'root_http=%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8000/
echo 'service_status='$(systemctl is-active photomap.service)
echo 'production_head='$(git rev-parse HEAD)
rm -f "$tmp" "$hdr" .dev/mpo-public-sample-a47d2e8.tsv
rm -rf .dev/frontend-dist-before-ca165a9
echo production_mpo_mime_deploy_verified
